notes.title: A teeny tiny patch to increase controller support
notes.notes: Try playing the Delusions of Maximillian Wust on your XBox controller! Which buttons have we assigned? It could be any of them! It could take moments to uncover the vagueries of the controller mapping. Entire moments.
